The Salesperson is a senior-level position responsible for assisting clients in raising funds in the capital markets, as well as in providing strategic advisory services for mergers, acquisitions and other types of financial transactions in coordination with the Institutional Banking team. The Director Salesperson also serves as an intermediary in trading for clients. The overall objective of this role is to act as strategic advisor to our clients by formulating investment strategies and raising capital for clients.
Responsibilities
Refine and implement sales/marketing strategy to improve Citi's client footprint and maximize associated revenue while working with management/colleagues to establish a clear marketing plan with defined priorities, market penetration and revenue goals
Leverage contact network to understand client needs, introduce the Citi offering, and convince clients to adopt it to increase client satisfaction/Citi revenue
Advise team in strategic positioning and closing transactions with various internal stakeholders (structuring, trading, legal, credit and risk etc.)
Forge a relationship with salespeople in order to leverage Citi's franchise and source relevant buying and selling opportunities for clients
Lead strong governance and controls
Work in close partnership with control functions such as Legal, Compliance, Market and Credit Risk, Audit, Finance in order to ensure appropriate governance and control infrastructure
Build a culture of responsible finance, good governance and supervision, expense discipline and ethics
Appropriately assess risk/reward of transactions when making business decisions; demonstrating proper consideration for the firm’s reputation
Be familiar with and adhere to Citi’s Code of Conduct and the Plan of Supervision for Global Markets and Securities Services
Adhere to all policies and procedures as defined by your role which will be communicated to you
Obtain and maintain all registrations/licenses which are required for your role, within the appropriate timeframe
Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.
Recommended Qualifications
15+ years of sales experience at a financial services organization
Experience in a client-facing role working with the buy-side community
Proven interpersonal and problem-solving skills
Consistently demonstrate clear and concise written and verbal communication
Broad client relationships preferred
Education
Bachelor's degree/University degree or equivalent experience
Master's degree preferred
Working Environment: office setting, minimal travelling and prolonged working hours in the office may be required during projects.
Effort: minimal physical effort required. High levels of prolonged and intense concentration may be required in front of computer.

We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this? By working together - and supporting each other - all over the world. So, join our team and feel like you’re part of something bigger.
About Your Team
Asset Management CAO
team
is responsible front to back, for the operational and supporting capabilities across investment management.
The Investment Management Solutions team is
a cross asset delivery & support function driving collaboration, consistency & execution across the global asset management platform. The team drives strategic initiatives, provide support services enabling our investment team, and partners with our investment leaders to strengthen oversight, risk controls & regional regulatory engagement. Within the IM Solutions function the
Sustainable Investing Solutions team
is responsible for supporting global FIL’s proxy voting activities as well as core governance & reporting activates underpinning FIL’s sustainable investment approach.
About Your Role
As the
SI Solutions - Senior Analyst
you will be responsible for maintaining documentation, executing core reporting responsibilities, designing & developing automated tools & capability to reduce manual processes for more efficiency and higher accuracy, and provide technical support on database management and business analysis. This role will support FIL’s investment, client services & workplace investing teams to produce reporting, analysis and data used to understand, describe & demonstrate FIL’s approach to sustainable investing.
About You
The successful candidate will be expected to develop a deep understanding of our current & future capabilities, FIL’s product & operational platform. The role will execute a variety of reporting-based deliveries across a broad stakeholder base, actively monitor the overall status of documentation, and proactively prepare & renew essential authorization documents. With the growing understanding on Sustainable Investing reporting functions, the role is expected to work with related stakeholders to deliver technical deliverables on different types of data warehouse related requirements and automation requirements. As data sets & global regulations focused on Sustainable Investing continues to rapidly develop, you will be expected to learn, adapt & evolve deliverables to meet evolving requirements.
Key Responsibilities
Collate information and data from voting platforms, internal records, and some from third-parties to produce voting and engagement reports.
Production of public voting activity disclosure reporting to meet regulations and local stewardship codes.
Produce climate reporting & quarterly reporting for Global Platform Solutions.
Identify automation opportunities and lead implementation where needed.
Support on database development, management, processing and optimizing.
Coordinate communications from the investment team and client services on sustainable reporting.
Assist on fund screening, bespoke exclusion reporting, and maintenance of supporting processes.
Produce data & reports as well as other administrative tasks required to integrate client facing vendor platforms
Assist on general ESG reporting projects and requirements.
Maintaining POA documentation and take end to end ownership of all processes.
Develop & maintain consolidated, auditable process documentation library.
Identify, drive and contribute to continuous process improvement.
Experience And Qualifications Required
Data analytical and automation skills - Python, SQL, PowerBI is required, experience of developing automation tool based on business requirement is highly preferred.
Experience with data management tool and database platoform - Snowflake, Azure, etc. is preferred
Highly efficient English communication skills in both writing and speaking. Japanese Language skills is preferred.
Background in finance related functions or business data reporting & support management is required.
Highly sufficient skills in Microsoft Excel, PPT is required.
Experience or qualifications within Sustainable Investment subject matters preferred.
Experience as Project Manager, Business Analyst, SME is a strong plus.
Demonstrated learning ability and interest in Investment knowledge. CFA related certificate is highly preferred.
Analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, strong attention to detail and dedication to manage tight deadlines
Strong interpersonal and communication skills, and highly developed teamwork skills
Global stakeholder management and global collaboration model experience is highly preferred.
A good team player with open-minded, flexible and positive attitude for changes.
Self-disciplined and self-motivated to drive business result with a clear career plan.
Able to manage stakeholder and deliver high quality work under pressure.
Feel rewarded
For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work – finding a balance that works for all of us. It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team. Demonstrates an AI-native mindset, applying AI-driven approaches to improve productivity, quality, and decision-making.
The Opportunity
As a Principal Engineer in Group AI Platforms, you’ll shape the technical strategy and provide architecture oversight for HSBC’s next-generation AI platform. You’ll help establish the engineering foundations that enable AI capabilities to be delivered reliably, securely and at scale across the Bank.
The role will focus on strengthening the resilience, scalability, performance and operability of core AI platform services, including the AI Gateway, security guardrails, model hosting and related foundation services. These capabilities are designed to provide dependable, always-on access to AI models and services across business applications—much like essential electricity infrastructure: consistently available when needed and capable of supporting high levels of demand.
You’ll help define the target architecture and engineering standards for a unified gateway ecosystem spanning LLM Gateway, MCP Gateway and Agent Gateway, alongside Guardrails as a Service. You’ll also identify and adopt relevant advances in AI and cloud-native engineering to ensure the platform remains secure, efficient and fit for the evolving needs of the Bank.
As a senior technical authority, you’ll establish engineering best practice, drive adoption across platform delivery teams and raise the standard for production readiness. You’ll champion AI-native development practices that improve delivery efficiency, software quality and engineering decision-making—while ensuring that human accountability, security, resilience and responsible use remain central.
What You Will Need To Succeed In The Role
Significant experience operating as a Principal Engineer or senior technical authority in a large-scale enterprise technology environment.
Extensive experience designing, building or operating shared platforms used by multiple product and application teams.
Strong experience with gateway platforms, service control planes, API mediation layers, service meshes or comparable enterprise integration platforms.
Experience designing platforms that support high availability, high concurrency, low latency, traffic management, rate limiting, routing, authentication and policy enforcement.
Practical understanding of security controls for AI systems, including: policy enforcement and access control; data protection and secure integration; auditability and traceability; model and capability governance; and runtime guardrails and monitoring.
Strong knowledge of production readiness, including non-functional requirements for resilience, observability, security, performance, scalability, operability and recoverability.
Working knowledge of Golang and/or Python for platform tooling, service integration, experimentation or adjacent production development.
Experience with Kubernetes and cloud-native production systems, including deployment patterns, networking, scaling, service discovery, resilience and incident troubleshooting.
Experience implementing modern delivery practices such as automated testing, continuous integration and delivery, canary deployment, progressive delivery, A/B testing and automated rollback.
Familiarity with LLM gateways, MCP-based integrations, agent platforms or comparable emerging AI infrastructure is desirable.
Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to explain complex technical trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
A collaborative leadership style and a commitment to knowledge sharing, coaching and raising engineering standards across a global team.

As a GLAM Relationship Specialist, you will help create a controlled and efficient experience for colleagues as they join, move within or leave the firm. You will build effective relationships with business stakeholders and partner teams to understand employee lifecycle needs and ensure timely resolution of requests. Working with Access Operations, Solutions teams and Technology partners, you will coordinate access to technology, applications, market data and buildings. The business will rely on you to help ensure each request is completed accurately, on time and in line with control standards. This role provides broad exposure to how the firm operates and an opportunity to improve the processes that support employee experience.
Job Responsibilities
Coordinate and track access needs for new hires, internal transfers, role changes and leavers.
Build effective relationships with business stakeholders and partner teams to understand employee lifecycle needs and keep requests moving.
Coordinate technology hardware, application, market data and building access requirements as needed.
Check requests against approved role requirements and confirm that the appropriate business and control approvals are in place.
Coordinate the prompt removal or amendment of access when employees leave or transfer.
Troubleshoot access and entitlement issues, working with Technology and support teams through to resolution.
Support regular access reviews and entitlement recertifications and coordinate the remediation of identified exceptions.
Maintain accurate and complete records of access requests, approvals and actions taken.
Partner with business managers and control functions to answer questions and support timely request completion.
Maintain a strong control and compliance environment and identify opportunities to reduce risk in daily processes.
Identify process gaps, escalate control concerns and contribute to improvements across access management and employee lifecycle processes.
Required Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills
Experience in operations, administrative support, technology support, or a similar role.
Proven ability to manage multiple requests, set priorities and follow tasks through completion.
Demonstrated accuracy and attention to detail when handling records, approvals or control processes.
Possess SAC license (or any other licenses / qualifications as required) for carrying out securities and other regulated activities.
Proficiency in written and spoken English.
Experience handling confidential information with discretion and professionalism
Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with business and support partners.
Strong command of MS office suite of products
Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills
Experience in access management, employee onboarding or offboarding, technology provisioning or operational support.
Experience working in financial services or another regulated industry.
Familiarity with access controls, entitlement reviews, issue tracking and audit support.
A track record of proactive problem-solving and process improvement.
About Us
J.P. Morgan is a global leader in financial services, providing strategic advice and products to the world's most prominent corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors. Our first-class business in a first-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. We strive to build trusted, long-term partnerships to help our clients achieve their business objectives.
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.
About The Team
J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

Job Type
Full Time
Job Reference #
343200BR
City
Wuxi
Key Responsibilities
Are you a great people manager? Do you enjoy getting the most out of your team every day? We are looking for someone like you to join our team. As team lead, you will be managing a growing team responsible for transactional reporting to regulators across the world. Your focus will be excellence and you will drive yourself and your team to deliver consistent results in the constantly changing regulatory landscape. You will work together with the Regulatory Reporting regional management team as well as global stakeholders to ensure obligations to the regulatory authorities are met.
The team
While based full time in Wuxi, you'll be working in a global team responsible for functions supporting transactional reporting to global regulators within tight deadlines. In our collaborative culture, the team works closely with a number of other teams to ensure UBS' obligations are met. You will work with people from all walks of life making this team diverse, sharing ideas and experiences to achieve common goals.
Your Skills And Experience
– managed dynamic teams before, ideally global teams
– an understanding of what it takes to create, maintain and retain a successful and driven team with motivated individuals
– have experience of the regulatory operations, or banking operations at a minimum
– excellent communication skills, both in person and remotely
– a track record of delivery
You are:
– a great communicator, you know how to speak with people at all levels
– an expert at challenging the status quo
– a team player and an inspiration to those around you
– excited to learn and grow in a firm where opportunity is everywhere!
About Us
UBS is a leading and truly global wealth manager and the leading universal bank in Switzerland. We also provide diversified asset management solutions and focused investment banking capabilities. Headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, UBS is present in more than 50 markets around the globe.
We know that great work is never done alone. That’s why we place collaboration at the heart of everything we do. Because together, we’re more than ourselves. Want to find out more? Visit ubs.com/careers.
Join us
At UBS, we know that it's our people, with their diverse skills, experiences and backgrounds, who drive our ongoing success. We’re dedicated to our craft and passionate about putting our people first, with new challenges, a supportive team, opportunities to grow and flexible working options when possible. Our inclusive culture brings out the best in our employees, wherever they are on their career journey. And we use artificial intelligence (AI) to work smarter and more efficiently. We also recognize that great work is never done alone. That’s why collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. Because together, we’re more than ourselves.
We’re committed to disability inclusion and if you need reasonable accommodation/adjustments throughout our recruitment process, you can always contact us.

UBS is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We respect and seek to empower each individual and support the diverse cultures, perspectives, skills and experiences within our workforce.
